## CLI global flags

```text
--output format      Output format: json, table, yaml (default json)
      --password string    Password for basic authentication (also read from SONAR_CLI_PASSWORD env var)
      --timeout duration   HTTP request timeout (default 30s)
      --token string       Authentication token (also read from SONAR_CLI_TOKEN env var)
      --url string         SonarQube server URL (also read from SONAR_CLI_URL env var)
      --username string    Username for basic authentication (also read from SONAR_CLI_USERNAME env var)
```
